channel.title: One Fire Record: China
channel.description: Is this month's fire activity normal for China? NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire detections joined into one record since 2000.

item.title: October 2026 in China: fire activity was above normal
item.description: 47,998 fire detections. In the 25 earlier Octobers on record, the middle year had 31,808. Near-real-time data: provisional.
